comments.value:
Hi @{5f3df2f75af9f322b0f66e1b|full_name}! Thank you for expressing your interest.

@{5a983204a1528d415c5ced46|full_name}'s comment summarizes it well: This Canny post is not marked as 'tracked' because we're not currently working on this feature. We'll let you know once that changes!

I've let the team know how important this request is to you. Adding Physbones is one of the most popular feature requests for the Worlds SDK, so I would be surprised if we don't implement it *eventually*.

(Edit: For posterity - "Tracked" means that we're tracking this issue in our internal issue tracker. It doesn't usually mean that we're working on it.)
@{63691297469f06772579fe6f|full_name} Thank you. I want to let you and your team know that WE strongly desire this most interesting feature as soon as possible.
@{63691297469f06772579fe6f|full_name} And, I might add, I would like to know WHY this most popular feature request is STILL not currently in the active plan.

If this does get added, please include contacts as well as physbones! It would be so nice to have avatar-to-udon and udon-to-avatar interactions withour having to rely on janky workarounds like log scraping

@{63691297469f06772579fe6f|full_name} Thank you for the update! Put this user down as one more requester of this feature. I have a whole world built that hinges on this functionality that's sitting dormant, and it would allow for such cool and innovative world interaction and people could get super creative with it.
This feature is already 4 years over due.... why hasn't it happened yet?
@{5f991dc310fe161214234298|full_name} I have no idea, I would LOVE to use physbones in worlds... i guess we'll just have to wait for the devs to decide they want to work on it :p

You should see here and remember that this place is for talking about to Open Beta, such as issues found, not for pressuring on VRC Team.

I know you're suggesting the world physbone feature to them many times, but I think this time is not a smart way to do it

We're working on adding dynamics to worlds!

Check our latest roadmap update for more info:

https://ask.vrchat.com/t/vrchat-creators-roadmap-july-2025/45859

Physbones are now available in the worlds SDK! Read the release notes below:

 https://vrc-beta-docs.netlify.app/releases/release-3-9-1/

Thank you to everyone who upvoted and commented on this request. And thank you to the VRChat team for taking the time to implement it!

details:
Physbones is really cool. In particular it has a performant set of tools that allow for avatar-avatar interaction.
Please port the Physbones code so we can use it in Worlds too! It would make making many Worlds things far easier, like buttons and levers.
